checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the 'Forms ribbons' checkpoint is untestable in a static image of a plated dessert. All other checkpoints were accurately assessed as present. The expert classifier strongly confirms the alignment (Top-1: chocolate sauce, logit 7.57), validating the visual assessment. The Router was not too lenient; the description matches the target class perfectly despite the presence of minor generation artifacts.
artifact_review: The Router identified a texture anomaly at the cake base (severity 2) and a structural collapse at the sauce-plate junction (severity 1). I agree with these findings but elevate the severity of the base texture issue. The cake base exhibits significant 'melting' or smearing into the plate/sauce interface, lacking the distinct crumb structure expected of a baked good. This 'Grounding_Failure' (noted by geometric_depth_auditor criteria) combined with the boundary ambiguity makes the object look partially synthetic/painterly. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no noise/blur, confirming the issue is structural/textural rather than resolution-based. The artifact score should reflect this noticeable lack of physical coherence at the contact points.
alignment_reasoning: Expert classifier confirms 'chocolate sauce' with high confidence (logit 7.57). Visual inspection confirms all testable checkpoints (gloss, viscosity, color, meniscus) are met. One dynamic checkpoint correctly marked N/A. Near-perfect semantic alignment.
artifact_reasoning: Router correctly flagged texture smearing at the cake base and boundary ambiguity at the sauce pool. The cake base lacks realistic crumb structure and appears to melt into the plate (grounding failure). While the sauce itself is glossy and convincing, the interaction with the solid cake and plate shows AI synthesis artifacts. Severity adjusted to reflect visible structural incoherence at the base.
